about: Provenance for the environments stream's Higgsfield images: each job id with its exact prompt and settings (review L14). The originals are not committed; apps/web/scripts/backdrops.py and house-ads.py turn them into the runtime files listed under `output`. Spend per batch is in art/README.md's cost table.

jobs.prompt: Wide panoramic sky backdrop for a stylised side-view video game, painted in soft matte gouache with simple rounded shapes. A calm late-morning sky over a warm tropical coastal city: soft powder blue at the top, fading smoothly to a pale hazy warm cream along the bottom edge. A few soft, rounded cumulus clouds and thin high wisps spread evenly across the whole width, gently lit from the upper left. Low contrast, slightly desaturated, airy and peaceful. Sky only: no ground, no buildings, no horizon line, no sun disc, no birds, no aircraft, no text, no logos.

Distant city skyline layer for a stylised side-view video game background, painted in soft flat matte gouache shapes. An original, invented West African coastal megacity inspired by Lagos (no real landmarks), seen from very far away on a hazy day: a dense band of low and mid-rise concrete blocks with flat roofs and small black rooftop water tanks, a few slender towers of different heights spaced across the width, two construction cranes, scattered palm trees, and a long low road bridge on concrete pillars across one part. Everything in soft hazy blue-grey with pale highlights, very low contrast and low saturation, strong aerial perspective. The buildings sit along the bottom edge and fill only the lower half of the image with an irregular, varied rooftop line; everything above the buildings is fully transparent. Flat orthographic side view, no ground, no water, no foreground, no people, no vehicles, no text, no signs, no logos.

Row of city buildings as a background layer for a stylised side-view video game, painted in soft matte gouache with simple shapes, toy-like and clean. A continuous row of original three- to nine-storey concrete apartment and office blocks from an invented West African coastal city inspired by Lagos, seen straight from the side: painted plaster in faded cream, ochre, terracotta, sage green and pale blue, small balconies with hanging laundry, louvred windows, black rooftop water tanks, satellite dishes, a few palm trees between the blocks and sagging overhead power lines. Soft hazy daylight, low contrast, muted colours. The buildings stand on the bottom edge and fill the lower two thirds of the image with a varied rooftop line; the sky above them is fully transparent. Flat orthographic side view, no ground, no street, no people, no vehicles, no billboards, no text, no signs, no logos, no lettering anywhere.

Wide panoramic space sky backdrop for a stylised side-view video game set on the Moon, painted in soft matte gouache with simple shapes. A deep black-blue sky with a dense, soft star field spread evenly across the whole width, a faint pale band of distant stars crossing it, and a large crescent Earth low in the upper left, glowing soft blue and white with swirling clouds. Calm, low contrast, painterly. Sky only: no ground, no horizon line, no mountains, no buildings, no spacecraft, no text, no logos.

Distant lunar landscape layer for a stylised side-view video game background, painted in soft flat matte gouache shapes. Grey cratered mountain ridges and rolling regolith hills of the Moon seen from far away, lit hard from a low sun on the left so each ridge has a pale lit side and a soft grey shadow side, a few distant crater rims. Very low contrast, cool neutral greys, no colour. The ridges sit along the bottom edge and fill the lower half of the image with an irregular outline; everything above the ridges is fully transparent with crisp edges, no glow, no haze. Flat orthographic side view, no buildings, no people, no vehicles, no text, no logos.

Hard low sunlight from the left, soft grey shadows, low contrast. The structures stand on the bottom edge and fill the lower two thirds of the image; everything above them is fully transparent with crisp edges, no glow, no haze. Flat orthographic side view, no people, no vehicles, no flags, no text, no logos, no orange, no bright blue.

Moody but readable, low contrast, desaturated, painterly. Sky only: no ground, no sea, no horizon line, no buildings, no ships, no birds, no text, no logos.

Very low contrast, desaturated. The port sits along the bottom edge and fills the lower half of the image with an irregular outline; everything above it is fully transparent with crisp edges, no glow, no haze, no sky. Flat orthographic side view, no water surface, no people, no text, no logos, no signs.

Row of old harbour buildings as a background layer for a stylised side-view video game, painted in soft matte gouache with simple shapes, toy-like and clean. Low contrast, desaturated, muted colours, no bright blue and no orange. The buildings stand on the bottom edge and fill the lower two thirds of the image; everything above them is fully transparent with crisp edges, no glow, no haze. Flat orthographic side view, no water, no people, no vehicles, no text, no signs, no logos.

Wide interior backdrop for a stylised side-view video game, painted in soft matte gouache with simple shapes: the far back wall of a huge original physics laboratory hall, seen straight on. Two great circular ring machines glowing soft cyan, tall glass containment cylinders, banks of panel lights, steel gantries and walkways, pipes and cable trays, ribbed wall panels and high clerestory windows letting in pale daylight. Cool clinical palette of steel greys and pale whites with soft cyan glows and a few small violet accents. Calm, evenly lit, low contrast, the whole frame filled with wall, floor at the very bottom edge and ceiling trusses at the very top edge. No people, no text, no logos, no signs.
